📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

Top 5: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND; PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY; INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY; NEM (1W: +6.44% | 1M: -1.48%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND; COF (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -10.08%) BELOW TREND; IBM (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND; GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY. Major divergence: multiple large-caps (PYPL, INTU, CRM, TTWO) showing 1W rebound while 1M remains negative — treat as tactical recoveries, not full trend confirmations.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is under pressure with broad downside. NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND while INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY — sector breadth negative (Technology: 24 stocks).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are soft and clustered at the downside. BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -10.08%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND with PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY the notable outlier — sector breadth negative (Financials: 20 stocks).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows defensive leadership and positive internals. JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND — sector breadth positive (Healthcare: 17 stocks).

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to pockets showing rotation: Materials and Energy names that are ABOVE TREND (FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +11.58%) ABOVE TREND) and select Communication/Utilities strength (NFLX, CEG). Reduce exposure to weakest Financials and large-cap Tech that remain BELOW TREND (BAC, GS, NVDA, MSFT). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; treat 1W recoveries as tactical opportunities pending 1M confirmation.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND; BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication and Utilities (rotation leaders; breadth positive). BEARISH: Technology and Financials (internals weak; multiple large caps BELOW TREND).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND — watch failure to reclaim last week’s range for continued downside. AAPL (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION — watch weekly follow-through above recent pivot to confirm trend. NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for consolidation above this week’s highs for continuation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+80): Eli Lilly oral GLP‑1 and Olumiant update; price confirming — LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND. PFE (+80): BRAFTOVI approval; price confirming — PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND. PYPL (+75): takeover interest; price showing short-term confirmation but 1M weakness — PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
JPM (-50): CLO/AI loan risk headline matches price weakness — JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND. TSLA (-45): exec exits and product concerns; price confirming weakness — TSLA (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND. WMT (-45): legal settlement headline is bearish but price diverges higher — WMT (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +9.76%) ABOVE TREND (sentiment diverging from price).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, style mixed / no clear leadership. NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is the major divergence—multiple large-caps (PYPL, INTU, CRM) in 1W recoveries while core Tech and Financials (NVDA, MSFT, BAC, GS) remain BELOW TREND; monitor news-driven catalysts for confirmation.
